note.es: Domingo, mercado cerrado: builtAt se reconstruyo hace 845 min (el cron de Netlify sigue vivo) y las fuentes por simbolo mas el webhook siguen congeladas desde el cierre del viernes ~21:01Z (~2750 min), el patron esperado de finde, no una falla nueva -- se resuelve solo con la reapertura del domingo ~22:00Z (~3h10 mas). Warn real: heartbeat sigue sin registrar el pre-asia del viernes (recurrencia del caso 2026-09-18, revisar scheduler; no hay commit de heartbeat.json entre el viernes 21:05Z y el sabado) y el journal sigue sin actualizarse hace ~162h con huecos desde el 2026-09-21.
note.en: Sunday, market closed: builtAt was rebuilt 845 min ago (the Netlify cron is still alive) while the per-symbol sources and webhook remain frozen since Friday's close ~21:01Z (~2750 min), the expected weekend pattern, not a new failure -- it resolves on its own at Sunday's reopen ~22:00Z (~3h10 away). Real warn items: heartbeat still shows no Friday pre-asia run (a recurrence of the 2026-09-18 case, check the scheduler; no heartbeat.json commit between Friday 21:05Z and Saturday) and the journal hasn't updated in ~162h with gaps since 2026-09-21.
